source.title: US Dam Hazard Classification - Corrected Edition

modes.preset: User picks a state or agency; the preset's scenarios, method IDs, parameters and class labels are loaded.
modes.custom: User ticks method IDs with no state or agency names shown; parameters stay editable; results use generic labels. Source citations are kept in the run report.

steps: Run every enabled scenario; the most severe consequence governs.
Sample hydraulics at every receptor and apply every enabled method; each hit returns class, receptor, method ID and strength.
Suggested class = highest rule-strength result across all receptors; advisories reported and applied only if opted in.
Report the driving receptor(s) and method ID(s) with every suggestion.

disclaimer: Output is a suggested classification only. The engineer of record and the regulating agency make the determination.
